_readme: Facts looked up from each vendor's own documentation, one at a time.
Each was proposed by one agent from a cited page and then independently
re-checked against that page by another; only the ones that survived are here.
An entry only fills a field the automatic sources left empty. To refresh one,
edit the value and move its `checked` date.
See provenance.json for what the last run actually used.
